Header.WeightDerived: Derived from the build (the stored figure is not read).
Header.CostDerived: Derived from the build (the stored figure is not read).
Header.TransferHint: Export this {kind} as an item file (its fitted parts ride along).
Header.TransferNeedsOwner: Only an item on a character can be exported as an item file.

Library.Hint: GM only: every slot offers the whole catalog (a design is placed, not built from owned rows).
Library.GmOnly: Direct Library Access is a GM switch.

Roll.NeedsOwner: Put this item on a character to roll it.

Condition.Title: Condition
Condition.DurabilityHint: Remaining Durability (Ch7); the maximum comes from the fitted components.
Condition.Unmeasured: Durability is not measured until a component is fitted.
Condition.NotMeasured: This weapon has no measured Durability to repair.
Condition.EnergyResHint: Durability against energy attacks (Beskar, Cortosis, wraps).
Condition.StressHint: Penetrating damage against Durability (Ch7): Damaged, Broken or Destroyed.
Condition.RepairHint: Restore Durability to its maximum and the condition to Fine. The repair roll itself is made in the crafting app.

Build.ReleaseBody: Take this build back to a design? Every owned component goes back to stock and the weapon reads as unbuilt until you confirm construction again.
Build.PlacedNotice: Assembly finalized: Direct Library Access enabled, construction sequence bypassed.
Build.BuiltNotice: Assembly finalized: the owned components are now installed in this weapon.
Build.UnownedNote: On a character, the slots offer the owned components first; here every slot shows the design only.

Blaster.StunHint: Stun setting: the bolt deals typed EP damage instead (Ch11).
Blaster.AmmoNeedsOwner: Loading a pack moves it out of a character's inventory - put this weapon on a character first.
Blaster.AmmoNotFound: No owned pack or cell with id {id}.
Blaster.Reclassified: Parts now make this a {family} rolling {skill}
Blaster.NoModClass: This weapon has no Chapter 11 mod class - fit a receiver and a grip first.

Melee.UnbalancedHint: Cannot parry in the turn it attacked (Ch12).
Melee.ModsNote: {n} treatment(s) fitted. A catalog treatment chosen under Direct Library Access becomes an owned mod row.

Saber.CouplerNote: A fitted Shared Coupler makes this a saberstaff: the pommel gives way to the coupler and the second blade's slots open.

Armor.FitHint: The wearer is SM {sm}; a gap of 1 is Ill-Fitting (-2 DX, -1 Move), 2 or more Unwearable (Ch13).
Armor.MaintenanceHint: Restore every location's DR to the listed figure. The repair roll itself is made in the crafting app.
Armor.NoDrEntries: No DR entries yet - reset them from the wearer's anatomy.
Armor.ResetDrHint: Regenerate one entry per covered hit location from the wearer's anatomy.
Armor.NoAnatomy: No anatomy to fit - put this piece on a character first.
Armor.ShieldUnknown: No shield profile recognised for this row.
Armor.NoWiredBacking: no Wired Backing: powered mods cannot be fitted
Armor.NoModSlots: This piece has no mod slots - fit a Frame.

Ammo.DepletedHint: The casing plus the remaining charge (ammunition-depletion).

Part.FracturedHint: A fractured crystal imposes an attack penalty (Ch12).

Cyber.FlawsHeld: Every mandatory flaw is on the sheet.
Cyber.FlawsWhenInstalled: Install the hardware to see the flaws Chapter 14 requires.

Starship.NoSystems: No systems derived yet - choose a chassis.
Starship.ModLimitNote: Ch15 allows an upgrade once per vessel unless its entry says otherwise; a duplicate is greyed with the reason.
Starship.DesignPointsNote: The DP builder's figures (app-own, no chapter citation); they feed the derivation beside the slots.

Vehicle.CategoryInferred: No category stored: inferred from the catalog profile, else the type.

Trait.QuirkLimit: {n} quirks on the sheet: only the first {max} bill (Ch6).
Trait.SpecifierTaken: "{specifier}" is a library entry of its own - add that one instead.
Trait.StoredBagNote: The stored bag applies only where the library does not know this name.

Power.AdjustedHint: FP cost adjusted by the character's Force alignment (Ch8).

Equipment.BlueprintRollsNote: Copy, brick and build rolls are made in the crafting app.

Effect.Expired: Effects expired: {names} ended with the turn.
Effect.CrashDismissed: Stimulant wore off: crashed, lost {ep} EP.

Engine.MissingExport: ShadowBase: the engine bundle is missing {names}. Melee/lightsaber derivation and JSON import are unavailable until the bundle is rebuilt.

EnforceEconomy.Name: Enforce the combat economy (reserved)
EnforceEconomy.Hint: Reserved for a later ruling; nothing reads it yet. The maneuver / EP economy and multiple-parry flags stay advisory chips in the Tactical HUD (2026-08-28 ruling: warn, never block).

NpcDefaultHidden.Name: Hide imported dossiers from players
NpcDefaultHidden.Hint: Actors created by Import Dossiers get default ownership None (GM eyes only) until you share them. Off: the world’s default ownership applies.

TokenRotationSync.Name: Sync token rotation with facing
TokenRotationSync.Hint: A character’s stored facing hexside turns its linked tokens (hexside × 60°, straight up = 0) and turning a token writes the nearest hexside back. Off by default: tokens rotate freely.

ShowHandbookChips.Name: Handbook shortcuts
ShowHandbookChips.Hint: Chips beside section headings that open the rules in the Tactical HUD.

ShowPointCosts.Name: Point costs
ShowPointCosts.Hint: What each attribute costs and what it is based on. Useful while building, noise at the table.

CompactRows.Name: Compact rows
CompactRows.Hint: Tightens the spacing between rows and sections on every ShadowBase window. Buttons and inputs keep their size.

StickySectionHeaders.Name: Pin section headers
StickySectionHeaders.Hint: Keeps a section’s heading in view while you scroll it. Turn off on a short screen, where it covers what you scrolled to.

ReduceMotion.Name: Reduce motion
ReduceMotion.Hint: Drops the panel and accordion animations on every ShadowBase window.

RememberOpenSections.Name: Remember open sections
RememberOpenSections.Hint: Reopen the sheet sections that were open last time, per character. Off: every section opens.

KeepRollHistory.Name: Keep the roll history
KeepRollHistory.Hint: Keep the Tactical HUD’s dice log across reloads rather than starting empty.

RollHistoryDepth.Name: Roll history depth
RollHistoryDepth.Hint: How many rolls the Tactical HUD’s history keeps per character.

NotificationDepth.Name: Notifications kept
NotificationDepth.Hint: How many past notifications the HUD bell keeps; at most one fewer may be pinned.

ApplyPosture.Name: Apply Posture Modifiers
ApplyPosture.Hint: Ch9: the character's posture (crouching, kneeling, lying, etc.) adjusts Move, defence and the foe's attack roll. Off records the posture on the sheet but leaves the numbers unmodified.

TrackElevation.Name: Track Elevation
TrackElevation.Hint: Shows the elevation field beside Facing and Posture, with an Active Effects line while off ground level. Off hides the field and keeps its value; no number on the sheet depends on it.

Import.InvalidJson: That is not a ShadowBase character file: {error}
Import.NotACharacterFile: {file} is not a ShadowBase character file or item file.
Import.Success: {name} imported: the sheet was replaced from the file.
Import.ConfirmBody: Replace everything on {name}'s sheet with the file? Every row is replaced.
Import.NoTransferKind: {name} has no item-file format (traits, skills and powers travel with the character).
Import.ItemPartsMissing: {name} arrived without its parts and is marked unbuilt.
Import.ItemUnrecognised: That file is not a ShadowBase item file.

Collision.Title: Same name already on the sheet
Collision.Body: {name} is already on this sheet. Replace it, import under a new name, stack the quantity, or ignore the file?

Sheet.EngineError: The rules engine could not calculate this character: {error}. Derived figures are unavailable until the data is repaired.

Basic.SpeciesHint: A Chapter 18 species applies its racial package as a layer; a write-in applies none.

Ledger.OtherHint: Points spent outside the sections above (special abilities the sheet does not itemise).

Pools.PinnedNote: Pinned in the header; edit the pools there.

Attr.PrimaryExplainer: Primary attributes (ST, DX, IQ, HT) determine many derived characteristics. Base 10 costs 0 points. Point costs for deviations are shown.
Attr.SecondaryExplainer: These are derived from primary attributes or can be bought up. Point costs for deviations from the base are shown. Calculated fields like Damage and Basic Lift update automatically.
Attr.DroidNote: Set by hardware (Ch17) — chassis, processor and parts state this number; change it in the Workshop, not here.

Combat.SweepHint: Re-run the turn sweep at the current counter: the free facing change returns, parries reset, expired effects go.
Combat.StunNote: Do Nothing only. Active Defenses at {penalty}. Roll {attr} each turn to recover.
Combat.OpenEffects: Open Active Effects in the Tactical HUD
Combat.PostureNotApplied: Recorded, not applied — Apply Posture Modifiers is off in sheet preferences.

Facing.LabelEngaged: Facing — threat is in your {arc} arc
Facing.Flanked: Flanked: Sneak Attack and similar traits apply. Damage and hit location are unchanged — Ch7 keeps the arc's effect on defenses alone.
Facing.CannotAttack: You cannot attack this target until you turn to bring it into your Front arc.
Facing.ClickToDefend: Click one on the dial to defend against it instead.
Facing.IdleExplain: Nothing is attacking, so no arc applies and every active defense is available. Click an empty hexside to place a threat there. With more than one on the board, click another to defend against that one instead; click the one you are already defending against to remove it. The inner disc turns you.
Facing.HexResolve: Threat on hexside {n} — click to resolve against it
Facing.HexRemove: Active threat on hexside {n} — click to remove

Align.Unaligned: Unaligned — no Self-Mastery or Bearing modifier. Ch8's thresholds begin at ±{threshold}.
Align.SelfMasteryText: {mod} to every self-control roll, and equally to Will rolls against fear, temptation, coercion or torture.
Align.BearingText: {intimidation} Intimidation, {trust} to rolls that depend on being trusted (Diplomacy, Savoir-Faire, Merchant in good faith). A concealed alignment may have the GM waive this for a scene.
Align.ReactionWhat: Modifies this character's rolls to persuade, impress, charm, intimidate, bargain with or command anyone who can perceive the trait (Ch4).
Align.Perception: Over a comlink {comlink}; in writing {writing} — a modifier applies only where the other party can perceive the trait.
Align.NotApplied: Not applied to any roll on this sheet — the figures above are alternatives, and the GM adds whichever one fits the scene.

Lang.ComprHint: Understands but cannot speak it — half cost, round up (Ch3)
Lang.FreeHint: Granted free (Bilingual, Polyglot, species, GM) — bills 0, recovers nothing if dropped (Ch18)
Lang.None: No languages recorded — every character has one free native tongue (Ch3).
Lang.LegacyBilled: Legacy entries still billed from text: {list}
Lang.TooManyFree: {count} free language entries, but only {allowed} covered ({coverage}) — GM adjudicates (Ch3/Ch4).
Lang.Talent: Language Talent: bought languages speak one step higher — never a free or native entry (Ch4).
Lang.Ladder: Ch3 ladder: Broken 1 · Accented 2 · Fluent 3 (the top) · Comprehension-only half, round up (1/1/2) · one free native at [0].
Lang.RepublicRaised: Republic-raised (+0 CP) — Basic becomes the one free native tongue; {tongue} is no longer free and is bought like any language.
Lang.RepublicRaisedCompr: Comprehension-only (a Wookiee can never speak Basic).
Lang.Illiterate: Literacy: Illiterate — cannot read or write in any language (Ch5 disadvantage, billed there).
Lang.Literate: Literacy: literate in every language known, at no cost — the priced exception is the Illiteracy disadvantage (Ch5).
Lang.LegacyLiteracyNote: Legacy literacy note from this save's old free-text field — literacy is now the line above; clear this once its content is recorded where it belongs.

Enc.JumpStandingTip: From standing: half the running figure, rounded down.
Enc.JumpVerticalTip: Straight up: a third of the running figure, rounded down, minimum 1.
Enc.JumpNote: Roll Jumping to clear the full distance; on a failure you cover half of it and land prone. Bonuses to the Jumping skill improve the roll, not the distance.
Enc.DefensesElsewhere: Dodge, Parry and Block with their rolls, the encumbrance table and the Armor roll are on the Inventory tab under Encumbrance & Defenses.

Details.DroidPower: Droids run on power cells (standard 100 PP). Consumption: 1 PP/hr (normal), 1 PP/min (strenuous). Low Power: <20 PP warning; <10 PP (-1 DX/IQ). Shutdown: 0 PP (IQ-2 roll for one final action).
Details.SmDroid: Derived from the build (Ch17) — part heights on the 6-ft-anchor rule, plus the chassis shape; change it in the Workshop, not here.
Details.SmFromSpecies: {species}'s Ch18 average set this. Enter a height and SM derives from it (Ch2's formula) — an individual figure, like Rokarr's 8 ft.
Details.SmEnterHeight: Enter a height and SM derives from it (Ch2's formula).
Details.SmSuggested: Ch2's table gives SM {sm} for this height.
Details.ApplySmAria: Apply the size modifier {sm} derived from the height
Details.CfPlaceholder: e.g., Core Worlds [1]; Outer Rim Scum [0]
Details.CfHint: One culture per line or separated by semicolons, cost in brackets: Core Worlds [1]. Your native culture is free: Ahto City [0]. Commas do not separate entries.

Narrative.NotesPlaceholder: Campaign notes, GM info, plot hooks, etc.

Droid.ConvertBody: Enabling Droid status clears your biological anatomy, and any edited ST/DX/IQ/HT values reset to the hardware baseline — a droid's attributes derive from its parts (Ch17), so the Workshop's chassis and components state the numbers from here. The −10 CP droid baseline package is granted alongside. Proceed with droid conversion?
Droid.ResetBody: Disabling Droid status will immediately reset your body plan to standard biological anatomy. Your current mechanical configuration will be cleared. Proceed with biological restoration?
Droid.BaselineGranted: Droid baseline granted: {count} Ch17 baseline traits added.
Droid.BaselineRemoved: Droid baseline removed: {count} granted baseline traits came off with the droid status.

Species.Alias: {typed} is Chapter 18's {head}. Stored as {head}, and its racial package applied. Both names are the book's.

Prefs.Title: Sheet Settings
Prefs.Hint: Saved on this client (Configure Settings › ShadowBase), not on the character.

Notice.RollsUnavailable: The roll module is not loaded.
Notice.HudUnavailable: The Tactical HUD is not available in this build.
Notice.FilePickerUnavailable: The file picker is not available.
Notice.DialogUnavailable: Dialogs are not available in this build.

Sheet.DeleteBody: Remove {name} from this sheet? Parts installed in it stay in inventory.
Sheet.NoPack: No compendium pack named {pack} is available.
Sheet.AppUnavailable: {app} arrives with a later unit; nothing to open yet.

Body.DamageProcessorHint: Open the Tactical HUD's Status tab: the Tactical Damage Processor applies a hit to a location.
Body.LoadoutHint: What each part of the body is wearing and holding.
Body.Unplaced: {name} is readied but has no free hand
Body.DrHint: Total DR at the location: innate plus worn armour, with typed riders (Ch13) where a piece names a damage type.
Body.ProtectedByHint: DR contributed by a piece worn elsewhere (Ch13: arm DR from the torso piece, face DR from a sealed head piece).
Body.NoAnatomy: No anatomy on this sheet. Configure it in the Anatomy Workshop.

Abilities.NoAdvantagesHint: Advantages are the edges your character brings to the table — Combat Reflexes, a Patron, an unusual sense. Each costs character points and buys a concrete mechanical benefit.
Abilities.NoDisadvantagesHint: Disadvantages are the flaws and burdens that give points back — codes of honour, enemies, a bad temper.
Abilities.NoQuirksHint: Quirks are minor traits worth -1 point each; the first five bill.
Abilities.NoSkillsHint: Skills are what the character has trained. Levels are rolled against on 3d6.
Abilities.NoPowersHint: Force powers are bought by name and level; Force Training gates the tier.
Abilities.NoFormsHint: A Form modifies attack and active defences while a lightsaber is readied. One Form is active at a time.

Technique.UniversalHint: Can be used with either melee or ranged weaponry.
Technique.UnarmedHint: Chapter 9: unarmed techniques roll the best of Brawling / Karate / Echani / Teräs Käsi.

Abilities.BaselineHint: Baseline points a species or template granted; only the difference is charged.
Abilities.NoDefault: No default: {skill}. Buy one of those skills to attempt this power.
Abilities.NoTechniqueTarget: No target: select a readied weapon, or buy the base skill.
Abilities.NoSaberBound: No readied lightsaber is bound to the active Form.

Weapon.MalfHint: Malfunction threshold: a natural roll of this or higher jams the weapon (Ch7).

Inventory.TotalCreditsLine: Credits on record: {credits} cr · Inventory value: {cost} cr
Inventory.LiftingStHint: Ch4's qualified Lifting ST feeds Basic Lift when on.
Inventory.Jump: Running jump {running} yd · standing {standing} yd · vertical {vertical} ft
Inventory.NoEquipmentHint: General gear, currencies, datacards and blueprints live here.
Inventory.WeightlessHint: Deliberately weightless (a datacard, a licence): suppresses the zero-weight warning.
Inventory.NoArmorHint: Armour is worn per location; Chapter 13 allows one base layer per location.
Inventory.BaseLayerSwapped: Base layer swapped: {names} came off — Chapter 13 allows one base-layer item per location.
Inventory.NoBoxes: No storage boxes. Create one to file gear away.
Inventory.PurgeBoxBody: Delete {name}? Everything filed in it is picked up first.

Vehicles.NoDefault: No default for this action's skills.
Vehicles.NoStarshipsHint: A starship carries nine damage-tracked systems and its armaments.
Vehicles.NoVehiclesHint: Terrestrial and atmospheric vehicles from Chapter 15.

Roll.PastHalfDamageHint: The target is beyond this weapon's 1/2D ({range}). Chapter 11: roll full damage, halve it, round down - no minimum.
Roll.ApplyHint: Apply through the Tactical HUD's Damage Processor.
Roll.FlawedItem: Built from a flawed schematic (Ch10 ghost glitch on a 17 or 18).
Roll.AutomaticFailure: FAILURE ({total} always fails; effective skill {target} is above 15, so not a critical)
Roll.GhostGlitch: Ghost glitch: built from a flawed schematic. Deconstruct and rebuild from a corrected Blueprint to put it right.
Roll.NoTarget: {label}: nothing to roll against (the chapter prints no default).
Roll.EngineUnavailable: {name}: the engine could not calculate this character; nothing to roll against.
Roll.FrightImmune: {name} is immune to Fright Checks; no roll is made.
Roll.StunnedNoAttack: {name} is stunned: Do Nothing is the only maneuver (Ch9). Roll to recover instead.
Roll.Unready: {weapon} is unready (◊): take a Ready maneuver first.
Roll.WeaponUnready: {weapon} is ◊ — unready after attacking until a Ready maneuver.
Roll.NoCharges: {weapon} has no charge left to fire.
Roll.NoDartsSelected: {weapon}: select darts for the volley first.
Roll.NotRollable: "{formula}" is not a dice expression ({reason}); resolve it by hand.
Roll.NoBlockImplement: no shield or saber in hand
Roll.ArcGate: no such defense against an attack from the {arc} (Ch7)
Roll.UnreadyGate: ◊ unready — take a Ready maneuver (or spend 1 EP on a Quick-Ready, Ch7) to restore it
Roll.UBlocked: Unbalanced (U) — attacked this turn, no Parry until the turn ends
Roll.CannotParryWith: {weapon} cannot parry (its skill is not a parrying skill)
Roll.CannotBlockWith: {weapon} cannot block (only a shield or a lightsaber blocks)
Roll.TechniqueNeedsWeapon: {name}: select a readied weapon for this technique.
Roll.CrewNoDefault: {action}: {skills} prints no default; nothing to roll.

Damage.Title: Damage: {location}
Damage.NoLocation: No such hit location on this character.

Note.IonBio: Ion Bio-Effect: x0.5 damage to EP. Harmless to HP. x2 vs Energy Shields.
Note.IonElectronic: Electronic Disruption: x1 damage. x2 vs Energy Shields.

Prompt.NeuralInterference: Neural Interference: ion surge drained {ep} EP.
Prompt.ShockBreach: SHOCK BREACH: roll HT-{n} to avoid physical stunning and falling prone.
Prompt.AcousticShock: ACOUSTIC SHOCK: roll HT-{n} to avoid stunning and deafness.
Prompt.InertTarget: Inert Target: toxic agent has no effect on synthetic components.
Prompt.SystemsOffline: SYSTEMS OFFLINE: ion impact dealt {n} damage and disabled unshielded electronic systems.
Prompt.ArmorCompromised: Protective Integrity Loss: equipment on {location} was compromised.
Prompt.Corrosion: Corrosive Erosion: permanently erode 1 DR per 5 points of basic damage dealt.
Prompt.LeakTriggered: {label} triggered: failure to stabilize will drain vitality/power.
Prompt.MajorWound: MAJOR WOUND! Roll HT{penalty} to avoid knockdown and stunning.

Drop.ReferenceOnly: {name} is a catalog pick, not an inventory item - choose it in the starship builder.
Drop.SkillConflict: {name} conflicts with a skill this sheet already holds under its other name (Ch3).
Drop.KitPartsMissing: {name} arrived without its parts and is marked unbuilt.
Drop.TemplateConfirmBody: Replace {actor}'s sheet with the template {template}? Every row on the sheet is replaced; the name is kept.

Handbook.Title: Handbook
Handbook.ChapterFailed: That chapter could not be loaded. It will be retried shortly.
Handbook.NoHeadings: No headings in this chapter match “{query}”.
Handbook.NoDetail: No further detail in this section.

Handbook.JournalUnavailable: The handbook compendium is not available here.

Hud.Title: Tactical HUD
Hud.Subtitle: Command center for real-time actions and status.
Hud.EngineUnavailable: The engine could not calculate this character; the HUD has nothing to show until the data is repaired.
Hud.BasicSpeedTitle: Basic Speed — turn order (Ch7): the highest acts first, DX breaks ties, never re-rolled.
Hud.TurnCounterTitle: Global Turn Counter: moving it sweeps expired effects, restores the free facing change and resets the parry tally.
Hud.SweepNowTitle: Re-run the turn sweep at the current counter (expired effects, facing change, parries).
Hud.ArcTitle: Facing arc of the incoming attack (Ch7): Front allows every defense, Side removes Block, Rear removes them all.
Hud.StunnedLine: Stunned ({type}): Do Nothing is the only maneuver; active defenses at −4; recover on {attribute} each turn (Ch9).
Hud.StunnedNotice: Stunned: attacks are locked until the recovery roll succeeds (Ch9).
Hud.Label: Label
Hud.MalfTitle: Malfunction threshold: a roll of this or more jams the weapon (the card's Malf, gas grade included).
Hud.ReadyTitle: The Ready maneuver (Ch7) clears ◊; nothing else does.
Hud.MarkUnreadyTitle: Mark this melee weapon unready (dropped, fumbled, or a GM ruling) until a Ready maneuver.
Hud.StunPenaltyTitle: Ch9: every active defense at −4 while stunned (already inside the figures shown).
Hud.TurnOrderTitle: Ch7: the highest Basic Speed acts first; ties go to the higher DX. Turn order is fixed every second and never re-rolled.
Hud.PostEconomyTitle: Post the current combat-economy advisories as a chat notice (warn only; the GM adjudicates).
Hud.SelectWeapon: Select a readied weapon for this technique.
Hud.FormNeedsSaber: Ready a lightsaber to roll with the Form.
Hud.NoSaberForForm: No readied lightsaber is bound to the active Form.
Hud.NoAbilities: No Force powers, techniques or Forms.
Hud.RecoverEpTitle: Characters recover 1 EP per 10 minutes of rest.
Hud.EffectDescriptionPlaceholder: What the effect does, in play
Hud.OpenProcessor: Open the Tactical Damage Processor on {location}
Hud.ProcessorHint: Evaluate kinetic impact and physiological response.
Hud.MajorWoundPreview: Major wound: an HT roll to avoid knockdown and stunning will be prompted.
Hud.CripplingPreview: Crippling: the location will be marked non-functional.
Hud.SeveringPreview: Severing: the location will be marked destroyed.
Hud.NoNotifications: Alerts you have seen are kept here.
Hud.PinLimit: At most {limit} pinned — unpin one first.
Hud.BellEmpty: Notifications — alerts you have seen are kept here
Hud.RollHistoryTitle: The last rolls, newest first (depth: a client setting).
Hud.NoRolls: No rolls yet. Results will appear here.
Hud.SettingsHint: Display settings — what the HUD keeps and how it behaves.
Hud.SettingsUnavailable: The HUD settings arrive with the settings module; the defaults apply until then.
Hud.KeepRollHistory: Keep the roll history across reloads

Common.EngineError: The engine could not read this sheet: {error}

Droid.ConstructionNote: Construction is for building your character or for GM-approved modifications — not an in-play respec. Once play begins, ask your GM before re-entering it.
Droid.UnlockBody: This droid is a locked, built character. Construction mode is for initial character building and GM-approved modifications only — it is not a free in-play respec. Re-entering it to swap hardware mid-campaign needs your GM's sign-off, and Ch17's modification rolls (and their failure consequences) apply to any part you fit or remove.
Droid.BuyHint: Ch17 parts arrive priced; the row lands in General Equipment and a built droid consumes it by name.

Next.Chassis: Choose a Main Chassis to begin.
Next.PowerCore: Fit a Power Core to unlock anatomy and processing.
Next.Head: Fit a Head Unit to unlock processors and sensor bays.
Next.Processor: Fit a Logic Processor — without one the droid cannot think.
Next.Limb: Add an arm or a leg to give it a way to act.

Droid.WarpedCount: {count} warped slot(s) — no new part until Structural Repair (Ch17).
Droid.PendingWork: A Ch17 modification is waiting on its roll: {name} (see the Crafting window).
Droid.AnatomyHint: {count} hit locations derived from the build; {stored} stored on the sheet.
Droid.AnatomySynced: Anatomy written: {count} hit locations now follow the build.
Droid.SlotWarped: Slot Warped: this mounting is violently warped — no new part until structural repairs (Ch17). Use Structural Repair on the slot.
Droid.SlotWarpedShort: Slot warped — no installs until structural repair (Ch17)
Droid.NoMechanicRoute: No route to Mechanic (Droids): structural repair needs the skill or a default (Ch17).
Droid.SlotRepaired: Slot Repaired: the mounting is trued and can take parts again (Ch17).
Droid.RepairFailed: Repair Failed: the warp resists — another hour of structural work, then a new roll (Ch17).
Droid.SwapComplete: Swap Complete: the old part comes out intact and the new one seats cleanly.
Droid.Uninstalled: Uninstalled: recovered intact and returned to inventory.

Fail.Warped: — the slot is warped: no installs until structural repair.

Anatomy.Hint: Configure physiological structure and graft hardware.
Anatomy.Reset: Anatomy Reset: standard humanoid body plan restored.
Anatomy.AttachedLost: Attached Part Lost: {names} went with it.
Anatomy.PlacementDroid: Where this sits on the frame — "dorsal mount, above the left shoulder"
Anatomy.PlacementOrganic: Where this sits on the body — "grows from the right shoulder blade, folds flat when unused"
Anatomy.LimbDrNote: Ch14: deteriorates 1 per full 5 damage; broken at 0. Repair it on the Inventory tab.
Anatomy.InnateDrHint: The body's own protection. Worn armour and grafted limbs add on top of it.

Loadout.Hint: What each part of the body is wearing and holding.
Loadout.DeflectorNote: Shield Projector (External hardpoint): DR {max} vs. energy over every hit location while active — blasters, ion, lightsabers. Slugs, melee and vibro-weapons pass through. Drains {drain} PP/min; collapses at 0 PP. Wear persists until the emitter is repaired (Electronics Repair).
Loadout.FieldCollapsed: Field collapsed — the core is at 0 PP.
Loadout.EmitterBroken: The emitter is Broken — no field until repaired.
Loadout.FieldWornOut: The field's output is worn to 0 — no field until repaired.
Loadout.TickTitle: Deduct one minute of field uptime ({drain} PP) from the core.
Loadout.Overloaded: Two weapons pinned to one hand.
Loadout.BeltsNote: Belts, cloaks and shields sit above the base layer rather than on one limb.
Loadout.Unplaced: {name} is readied but has no {limb} free
Loadout.BaseLayerSwapped: Base layer swapped: Ch13 allows one base-layer item per location, so {names} came off.
Loadout.NoSuchArmor: No such armor row on this sheet.
Loadout.IncompleteWeapon: Incomplete Weapon: this must be fully assembled before it can be readied.
Loadout.TwoHanded: Two-handed: {name} takes a second hand as well.

Suits.PickerHint: Popular combinations, not fixed bundles. Adding one deals its pieces out to their body slots, where any single row can then be swapped, modded or removed on its own.
Suits.ClothingHidden: Clothing sets have no armour class and are hidden.
Suits.Unresolved: Not in the catalog, so it will not be added: {names}
Suits.Conflicts: Already wearing base-layer gear on {locations}. Ch13 allows one base layer per location — remove or unequip the old piece, or these will stack.
Suits.SkippedOne: {names} is not worn in an armour slot — add it from the inventory instead.
Suits.SkippedMany: {names} are not worn in an armour slot — add them from the inventory instead.

Crafting.PickerHint: Forge a design from the Blueprint catalog (its Blueprint in hand and its raw materials in stock), or take an owned item apart.
Crafting.MaterialsShort: Not enough raw material in stock for this build.
Crafting.DesignerRoute: {name} is composed in {where} — it has no flat catalog row to forge here.
Crafting.NothingToTearDown: Nothing on this sheet can be taken apart.

Description.SaberForge: The hilt is a vessel; the crystal is the heart.
Description.SaberSalvage: Stripping a pressurized energy matrix is hazardous.
Description.Handloaded: Reloading a spent casing rather than forging a new one.
Description.Improvised: Field-expedient construction, from whatever scrap is to hand.
Description.Build: Assembled from raw material, one phase at a time.
Description.Salvage: Stripped for raw material; nothing comes back intact.
Description.Swap: Swapping a fitted component for another.
Description.Deconstruct: Taken apart carefully, to keep the components whole.

Crafting.MarkupNote: Ch10: each step is marked up by the difficulty of the skill it needs. Pre-built parts you bought are added at their own price and are never marked up a second time.
Crafting.MarkupCh13: Ch13 overrides that for armour components — every one takes ×2 whatever skill fabricates it, so a component's price always reconciles with the Piece's Base Cost.
Crafting.NoDefault: No default for this skill: {skill} cannot be attempted untrained (Ch3). Train it, or a skill it defaults from.
Crafting.WriteBlueprint: Record a Blueprint of this teardown - adds a Computer Operation write roll and consumes a blank Datacard on success (Ch10: Blueprints).
Crafting.WriteBlueprintUnavailable: A blank Datacard in inventory would allow recording a Blueprint of this teardown (Ch10: Blueprints). Salvaging never yields one.
Crafting.DesignOriginal: Design this from scratch - prepends the Phase 0 Engineer roll and the Blueprint Write (consumes a blank Datacard), and the build runs at -1 until the fresh design proves itself (Ch10: Blueprints).
Crafting.DesignUnavailable: A blank Datacard in inventory would allow an Original Design here (Ch10: Blueprints).
Crafting.NoCardCovers: Every build requires its Blueprint in hand (Ch10) - keyed to the exact design, material and all. No carried card covers {name}: buy its Blueprint, deconstruct an example, or author an Original Design above.
Crafting.ProvenPlan: Proven plan - this build rolls at the baseline (0).
Crafting.BonusLine: {bonus} to every Crafting Phase roll of this build.
Crafting.BonusLineUnproven: {bonus} to every Crafting Phase roll of this build - unproven until its first successful build.
Crafting.NoFirmwareCards: This build flashes firmware: it needs the program's Datacard in hand as well as the Blueprint (Ch10's two-card rule). The card is a tool - it is read, not consumed. Author, buy, or salvage one first.
Crafting.WorkspaceForced: Ch11: Improvised Rounds are built at the Improvised/Field Tools penalty ({applied}) regardless of what workspace is actually available - makeshift construction imposes its own penalty. Rolling at {applied}, not {chosen}.
Crafting.ExtraTimeNoBonus: Ch10: the extra-time bonus only applies when crafting with Improvised or Basic tools. A properly equipped shop is already working at full speed - the longer schedule still costs the time, but grants no bonus.

DoneText.SaberFlawed: The matrix resonates, but a hidden stress fracture persists. The weapon may be unstable.
DoneText.Flawed: It holds together, but a flaw runs through it. The item may be unstable.
DoneText.SaberClean: The crystal is perfectly attuned. The blade ignites with a hum of pure harmony.
DoneText.Clean: The build completes cleanly and the item is ready for use.
DoneText.Rough: Components processed, but the crystal came out with micro-fractures — a permanent −1 to hit if it is ever reused (Ch12).

Crafting.AbortedText: Sequence termination due to component failure. Loss of materials recorded.
Crafting.CannotAbort: A failed run cannot be abandoned: confirm the result so its consequences apply.
Crafting.GateBlueprint: Every build requires its Blueprint in hand (Ch10).
Crafting.GateFirmware: This build needs its firmware Datacard declared (Ch10).
Crafting.NoBlueprintInHand: No Blueprint in hand: every build requires its Blueprint (Ch10). None of your cards covers {name} - buy one, deconstruct an example, or author an Original Design.
Crafting.NoFirmwareCard: No firmware Datacard: this build flashes firmware, which needs the program's Datacard in hand as well as the Blueprint (Ch10).
Crafting.ComponentRuined: Ch10 [112]: the critical failure ruined a fitted component - {name} is destroyed.
Crafting.Deconstructed: {name} taken apart: {kept} component(s) recovered intact, {pounds} lb of material credited.
Crafting.Salvaged: {name} salvaged: {pounds} lb of raw material credited ({rate}%).
Crafting.CrafterHurt: The crafter takes {damage} damage (current HP reduced).

PolicyHint.skip: Leave the archived dossier as it is; the file is not written.
PolicyHint.overwrite: Replace the archived dossier with the file.
PolicyHint.copy: Archive the file beside the original as "Name (1)".

WorldUpdate.Title: World update to species-package revision {revision}
WorldUpdate.Summary: {count} actor(s) in this world were brought to what the website gives a saved character on load (revision {revision}).
WorldUpdate.MarkedOnly: {count} of them only had their racial rows marked as their species' own (no trait added, removed or repriced).
WorldUpdate.Unchanged: {count} of them needed no change at all: nothing in this revision applies to their species, so only the revision was recorded.
WorldUpdate.Failed: Could not update: {names}. They stay below the revision and will be tried again when the world next loads.
WorldUpdate.Notify: ShadowBase: {count} actor(s) updated to species-package revision {revision}. The details are in chat (GM only).
